fr_html: Mr. Root reconnaît que les observations de M. de Lapradelle l'invitent à penser qu'il faut augmenter l'importance des juges suppléants. Il est disposé à abandonner la position qu'il a prise précédemment en ce qui concerne le droit pour les juges suppléants, de prendre part à l'élection du Président de la Cour. Il est disposé à donner ce droit aux juges suppléants afin de donner aux pays dont ils sont les ressortissants, l'impression qu'ils sont représentés à la Cour par des personnes d'une dignité égale à celle des juges titulaires.
en_html: Mr. Root said that M. de Lapradelle's remarks had led him to think that the importance of the position of the deputy judges should be increased. He was inclined to abandon his previous standpoint with regard to the question as to whether the deputy judges should have the right to take part in the election of the President of the Court. He was now disposed to give the deputy judges this right, in order to make their respective countries feel that they were represented upon the Court by Members holding a position equal to that of the regular judges.

He was inclined to abandon his previous standpoint with regard to the question as to whether the deputy judges should have the right to take part in the election of the President of the Court.
